title: Barbarians at the Gate: AI-driven research for systems (ADRS)
summary: An LLM-driven generate-evaluate-refine loop built on OpenEvolve produced systems algorithms in case studies, with the abstract reporting up to 5.0x runtime improvements or 50% cost reductions over baselines. Solutions are checked with simulators or real systems, which is the validation basis. The results are on specific case studies rather than a general claim, and the work is a preprint.
ai_technology: OpenEvolve (LLM-driven evolutionary code search, ADRS framework)
